title: Future Tense 6: Mixed Review
description: Synthesis of the whole future tense: the future of быть, the two-word imperfective future, the one-word perfective future, choosing between them, and the future time words.
descriptionRussian: Повторение всего будущего времени: будущее глагола быть, двусловное имперфективное будущее, однословное перфективное будущее, выбор между ними и слова времени.
intro: Everything from the last five lessons together. Three questions settle any future sentence: is this just быть on its own, is the action a process or a result, and which person is doing it. Get those in that order and the form follows. Nothing here is labeled.
rules: The future of быть: буду / будешь / будет / будем / будете / будут. Alone it means 'will be'; with an imperfective infinitive it builds the two-word future.
Two-word future (буду + impf infinitive) for processes and habits; one-word perfective future for single finished results.
Буду never pairs with a perfective infinitive: 'буду прочитать' is ungrammatical.
Cue words decide the choice: весь день / каждый день / часто → two-word; до пятницы / за час / a one-time promise → one-word.
Four-step diagnostic: just быть? → process or result? → person → form.
examples: Через час я буду дома. (In an hour I will be home.) Plain future of быть.
Летом я буду работать в кафе. (In the summer I will be working in a cafe.) Two-word future: a stretch of activity.
Я прочитаю книгу до пятницы. (I will read the book by Friday.) One-word future: deadline.
Мы будем гулять каждое утро. (We will walk every morning.) Habit → two-word future.
Я позвоню тебе вечером. (I will call you tonight.) Promise of one act → one-word future.
Скоро будут каникулы. (The holidays are coming soon.) Будут agrees with plural каникулы.

tables.title: The Whole Future Tense on One Page

rows.label: буду (alone)
cells: will be / will have: Я буду дома.

rows.label: буду + infinitive
cells: process, habit: буду читать весь день

items.promptEnglish: In a week we will have holidays.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 5: 'in a week' = after a week passes.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 5. 'In a week' is через неделю - через + a time span. Today's drill mixes all five lessons.

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will be reading the book all day.
items.hint: Step 2: 'весь день' is a duration cue. Which construction?
items.explanation: 'Весь день' marks a long stretch of activity → two-word future: буду читать.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will write (and finish) the article by Monday.
items.hint: Step 2: 'к понедельнику' is a deadline. Step 3: 3sg.
items.explanation: 'К понедельнику' is a deadline - the writing must finish - so the one-word perfective future, 3sg: напишет.

items.promptEnglish: Will you be at the meeting on Friday? (polite)
items.hint: Step 1: just быть. Step 3: polite вы.
items.explanation: The verb is plain быть ('will be at the meeting'), so the Lesson 1 form is the whole answer. Polite вы takes будете.

items.promptEnglish: I will definitely call you tomorrow.
items.hint: Обязательно signals a promise of one act.
items.explanation: A promise of one call → one-word perfective future: позвоню. Обязательно is a promise word, and promises of one act take the perfective.

items.prompt: Мы _____ гулять в парке каждое утро.
items.promptEnglish: We will walk in the park every morning.
items.hint: Habit cue → two-word future. Match the auxiliary to мы.
items.explanation: 'Каждое утро' is a habit cue → two-word future. The auxiliary agrees with мы: будем гулять.

blanks: Сначала я сделаю уроки, потом _____ смотреть фильм. (First I will do my homework, then I will watch a film.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: The sequence: first a completed step (сделаю - one-word future), then an activity (буду смотреть - two-word future). The auxiliary agrees with я: буду.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я буду прочитать эту книгу за неделю.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I will read this book in a week.
errorCorrection.explanation: Буду never pairs with a perfective infinitive. 'За неделю' marks completion within a week, so the one-word perfective future: прочитаю.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: They will be at the cinema in the evening.
errorCorrection.explanation: Они takes the 3pl form: будут. Будет is 3sg. Plain future of быть, Lesson 1.

errorCorrection.sentence: Лена погуляет в парке каждый день этим летом.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Lena will walk in the park every day this summer.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Каждый день' is a habit cue, which needs the two-word future: будет гулять. Погуляет means one short walk - incompatible with a daily habit.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I will call you when I arrive (one call).
minimalPairs.explanation: One call upon arrival is a single bounded act → one-word perfective future: позвоню.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: In winter we will be sitting at home in the evenings.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'По вечерам' (in the evenings, repeatedly) is a habit cue → two-word future: будем сидеть. Посидим would mean one short sit.

patternRecognition.question: Which rule produces буду here?
options: The two-word future with a dropped infinitive
The plain future of быть: 'will be' at a place
The one-word perfective future of бывать
patternRecognition.answer: The plain future of быть: 'will be' at a place
patternRecognition.explanation: No other verb is involved - the sentence just says where I will be. That is the Lesson 1 use of буду on its own.

patternRecognition.sentence: Летом Антон будет работать в кафе.
patternRecognition.question: Why the two-word будет работать instead of поработает?
options: A summer-long activity is a process, so the two-word future
Антон requires the auxiliary будет with every verb
patternRecognition.answer: A summer-long activity is a process, so the two-word future
patternRecognition.explanation: A stretch of activity (the whole summer) is a process → буду + infinitive. Поработает exists but means 'will work for a little while once'.

patternRecognition.question: Which rule produces the one-word напишу?
options: A perfective verb with present-tense endings reads as future
Present tense used for the near future
Написать is irregular in the future
patternRecognition.answer: A perfective verb with present-tense endings reads as future
patternRecognition.explanation: Написать is perfective; perfective verbs have no present tense, so their conjugated forms automatically read as future: напишу = 'I will write (and finish)'.

patternRecognition.question: Why is the verb будут plural?
options: Food words always take the plural
Будут agrees with пельмени, the thing that will exist
patternRecognition.answer: Будут agrees with пельмени, the thing that will exist
patternRecognition.explanation: In 'there will be X' sentences the verb agrees with X. Пельмени is plural, so будут. With soup: На ужин будет суп.

reviewVocab.definition: the four-step diagnostic for any future form: just быть? → process or result? → person → form
reviewVocab.example: Шаг 1: только быть? Нет. Шаг 2: процесс (весь день). Шаг 3: я. Шаг 4: буду читать.

reviewVocab.definition: the two-word future (буду + imperfective infinitive) for processes and habits
reviewVocab.example: Завтра я буду читать весь день.

reviewVocab.definition: the one-word perfective future for single finished results
reviewVocab.example: Я прочитаю книгу до пятницы и позвоню тебе.
